newsitem.title: USA: Buckle July same-store sales rise 14.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Buckle July same-store sales rise 14.4 pct.

text.p: Buckle Inc said Thursday its same-store sales for the four weeks ended August 2 rose 14.4 percent from the same period a year ago.
Total sales in July increased 27.4 percent from last year to $21.8 million.

Comparable store sales year-to-date were up 12.8 percent from sales in the same 26-week period of the previous year. Net sales year-to-date, for the 26 weeks ended August 2 increased 24.4 percent to $103.5 million from $83.2 million for the corresponding 26 weeks in the prior year.
The Buckle operates 192 retail stores in 25 states, compared with 174 stores in 22 states at this same time a year ago.
